versions.changelog:
Initial release of the fund administration and finance operations skillset, providing core tools for financial fund admin teams.

- Supports GL reconciliation, break tracing, accrual schedules, roll-forwards, variance commentary, and NAV tie-out.
- Individual skills include: accrual-schedule, break-trace, gl-recon, and nav-tieout with detailed operational logic and output formats.
- Designed for use during fund month-end close and reconciliation workflows, aiding in error identification and draft journal preparation.
- Emphasizes staging outputs for controller or operational review—no automated posting or adjustments.
